source_facts.11379879: Human CNGB1 G993V cosegregates with recessive retinitis pigmentosa in the studied family.
source_facts.15557452: A patient with a homozygous CNGB1 splice-donor variant has retinal degeneration and nonrecordable electroretinograms.
source_facts.19299621: Human CNGB1 C-terminal sequences bind ankyrin-G and support targeting of assembled rod channels.
source_facts.20890309: GRB14 associates with rod-channel beta-containing preparations; exact human beta construct and interface scope remain limited.
source_facts.24164424: Mixed human-beta/bovine-alpha channels conduct cGMP-dependent cation currents and show altered gating after matrix metalloproteinase treatment.
source_facts.34699778: Human rod CNGA1/CNGB1 forms a 3:1 cGMP-gated cation channel; beta contributes ligand recognition, the pore and asymmetric gating.
source_facts.7479749: Human CNGA1 mutations impair channel function and targeting; this is not a direct CNGB1 perturbation experiment.
source_facts.7682292: Cloned human beta does not produce functional channels alone but confers native-like behavior when coexpressed with human alpha.
source_facts.16407240: Native bovine GARP2 binds PDE6 and suppresses nonactivated basal activity, without significant suppression of the tested activated enzyme.
source_facts.7590744: The historical human GARP clone corresponds to the current GARP2 architecture with the documented R100H sequence difference.
source_facts.15634774: Mouse Cngb1 channel disruption reduces rod current and channel abundance before progressive retinal degeneration, while soluble GARP expression remains.
source_facts.10352032: Recombinant bovine alpha/beta rod channels conduct sodium and calcium, with ligand- and assembly-dependent relative permeability.
source_facts.16980309: Mouse Cngb1 is required for normal ciliary channel abundance, cAMP sensitivity and kinetics of olfactory electrical signaling.
source_facts.10377344: Rat olfactory B1b assembles with the olfactory alpha subunits and contributes native-like cAMP sensitivity, sodium/potassium conduction and gating.
source_facts.28053034: CNGB1 CaM-site/NCKX4 perturbation alters adult olfactory responses and OMP amount, without a reduced OMP-positive neuron fraction or changed GAP43 signal.
source_facts.21809342: Rat cultured granule cells show beta-containing CNG-channel signals at presynaptic sites and channel-associated calcium responses.
source_facts.41131016: An engineered human olfactory 2:1:1 channel undergoes cAMP-dependent activation and CaM-dependent inhibition, with beta contributing pore and feedback machinery.
